note: Art-direction packs for dating/social store images. Palettes drive the poster wrapper; the app UI keeps its own product palette. Cast prompts are for fictional adults only, fully clothed and non-explicit.

packs.name: After Hours Amber
packs.mood: Late-night city editorial: deep ink, amber streetlight, quiet intimacy.
packs.display: Heavy sans headline, serif italic second line, small uppercase pill badge.
packs.background_prompt: Abstract late-night city bokeh, deep ink field, amber streetlight glow, fine 35mm grain, generous negative space, no text, no people, no logo, no device.
packs.cast_prompt: candid 35mm portrait, warm streetlight, night city bokeh, natural skin, fully clothed, editorial, relaxed
packs.avoid: neon overload, fake ratings, heart clichés
